title: Treasury Analyst
description:
At MiniMed, you can begin a lifelong career of exploration and innovation, while helping make a difference in the lives of people living with diabetes around the globe. You'll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation for a more connected, compassionate world.
   

  

**About The Role**
 A Day in the Life
   

  

 Our Global Diabetes Capability Center in Pune is expanding to serve more people living with diabetes globally. Our state\-of\-the\-art facility is dedicated to transforming diabetes management through innovative solutions and Technologies that reduce the burden of living with diabetes.
   

  

 This position is an exciting opportunity to work with Minimed’s Diabetes business. Medtronic has announced its intention to separate the Diabetes division to promote future growth and innovation within the business and reallocate investments and resources across Medtronic, subject to applicable information and consultation requirements. This separation provides our team with a bold opportunity to unleash our potential, enabling us to operate with greater speed and agility. As a separate entity, we anticipate leveraging increased investments to drive meaningful innovation and enhance our impact on patient care.
   

  

 \#BetterDaysStartNow
   

  

**Job Description**
 The MiniMed Corporate Treasury Department manages the company’s cash and investments to ensure adequate liquidity for operating entities around the world, builds and maintains bank relationships, and seeks to reduce the financial risk arising from foreign currency exposures.
   

  

 Treasury works closely with internal stakeholders across finance, accounting, tax, HR, IT, legal and others, as well as external stakeholders including banks, investment firms, and other financial counterparties to achieve its objectives.
   

  

 We are looking for a highly skilled Treasury Analyst to help execute our global treasury operations and help design and build our expanding treasury infrastructure. The ideal candidate brings an understanding of cash management operations and financial risk management with experience in a multinational firm with a global presence.
   

  

**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:**
* Work closely with banks on integrating banking systems with MiniMed financial systems for efficient payment processing and financial reporting.
* Monitor daily cash positions across multiple currencies and legal entities to ensure adequate operational liquidity for our global business.
* Execute wire transfers, intercompany funding, and other cash transfer activities.
* Create BI dashboards to drive actionable insights to inform process improvements and reduce financial risks.
* Identify, track, and analyze FX exposure, and assist in designing FX hedging strategies to mitigate currency risk.
* Perform financial analyses to help drive global treasury decision\-making.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams to drive business performance.
* Perform SOX control reporting requirements
* Act as system administrator in bank portals and Treasury systems
* Global bank account administration


**Required Knowledge And Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or related field of study and experience working in a multinational company
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills
* Ability to develop solutions and/or innovative ideas to problems and ensure that solutions are consistent with the organization’s objectives.
* Ability to interface in a global team environment with various levels of management, staff, and other functional areas
* Strong organizational and people skills with interests in building strong business partnering relationships.


**Physical Job Requirements**
 The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.
   

  

**Benefits \& Compensation**
**MiniMed offers a competitive salary and flexible benefits package**
 At MiniMed, we put people first. A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values: We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every stage of your career and life.
   

  

**About MiniMed**
 We want to make every day a better day for people living with diabetes. Our team of creative innovators around the globe share a passion for finding the simplest solutions to the problems that people with diabetes face on a daily basis. For more than 40 years, we've been redefining what's possible, from intelligent dosing systems designed for real life to predictive insights that stay a step ahead, and we're dedicated to continuing to support our customers through every step of their journey — meeting them where and how they need it.

title: FS-RC-FSRM - CSTC-FA and R-Staff
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Risk Consulting – Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) – Staff**
**Description**
 EY's Financial Services Office (FSO) is a unique, industry\-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. FSO practice provides integrated consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, investment banks, broker\-dealers, asset managers (traditional and alternative), insurance and energy trading companies, and the Corporate Treasury functions of leading Fortune 500 Companies. The service offerings provided by the FSO Consulting include: market, credit and operational risk management, regulatory consulting, quantitative consulting, structured finance transaction, actuarial consulting, technology enablement, risk and security, program consulting, and process \& controls.
   

  

 Within EY’s Risk Consulting Practice, the Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group provides solutions that can help FSO clients to identify, measure, manage and monitor the market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks associated with their trading, asset\-liability management, capital management and other capital markets activities.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As part of the financial analysis of the bank’s exposures to a diverse range of public, semi‑public, and private counterparties \- including local authorities and their affiliates, public institutions, sovereigns, public financial institutions, SPVs, corporates, PPP/concession companies, and sponsors \- analysts will support credit‑risk assessments and contribute to internal‑rating activities across France and key international markets (primarily France, Italy, Spain, the UK, and, to a lesser extent, the US).
   

  

**Core Responsibilities:**
* Support the collection, quality review, and analysis of financial statements and key risk data for relevant counterparties.
* Assist in the preparation, structuring, and validation of input files and data flows used in rating processes and engines.
* Contribute to the drafting of financial analysis reports / credit memos, including key drivers, risks/mitigants, and preliminary views on ratings/outlooks, under supervision.
* Perform controls and reconciliations to ensure data quality, completeness, and consistency prior to processing.
* For French public sector entities, support data preprocessing and preparation of inputs for mass processing in the rating engine (as applicable).
* Collaborate with business and IT stakeholders to support day\-to\-day operations and contribute to process improvements and documentation updates.
* Build, review, and validate financial models with strong command of Excel;
* Analyze large datasets and generate comparative insights (experience with Power BI/SQL is an advantage).


**Domain Skills Required:**
* Conduct in‑depth financial analysis, including detailed review of public‑sector and corporate financial statements (IFRS/French GAAP), ratio assessments (leverage, coverage, liquidity), evaluation of working capital requirements, and comprehensive cash‑flow analysis.
* Apply project‑finance principles to assess SPV cash‑flow structures, DSCR/LLCR metrics, debt‑sizing considerations, covenant frameworks, reserve mechanisms, security packages, and risk‑allocation structures across concession and PPP projects.
* Evaluate sovereign and quasi‑sovereign credit risk by analyzing institutional frameworks, governance quality, policy stability, and levels of explicit or implicit government support.
* Perform corporate and sectoral assessments by analyzing business models, industry dynamics, competitive positioning (utilities, transportation, energy, social infrastructure), and conducting sensitivity and benchmarking analyses across markets.
* Review and interpret financing documentation, including term sheets, loan documentation, covenant packages, guarantees, and where applicable key provisions within bond indentures.
* Prepare clear, structured, and analytically sound credit memoranda, including rating recommendations, risk/mitigation assessments, and identification of early‑warning indicators.
* Support and conduct gap assessments, impact analyses, and business‑readiness evaluations related to regulatory change initiatives.
* Demonstrate strong technical expertise and up‑to‑date industry knowledge across financial products, market practices, and risk methodologies.
* Lead key workstreams within large‑scale client engagements or independently manage smaller engagements, ensuring consistent delivery of high‑quality outcomes.
* Review outputs prepared by team members to ensure analytical quality, completeness, and adherence to internal standards.
* Stay informed of emerging trends, regulatory changes, and sector‑specific developments to anticipate client needs and strengthen advisory delivery.
* Monitor project progress, proactively manage risks, and communicate priorities, challenges, and updates effectively to stakeholders.
* Mentor and guide junior consultants, fostering skill development, knowledge sharing, and professional growth within the team.


**Qualifications, Certifications And Education**
**Must\-have:**
* Master’s degree in Business Administration (Finance/Economics) or CA qualification, with 1\-4 years of relevant experience in financial analysis or risk‑related roles.
* Foundational experience (internship/apprenticeship/junior role) in financial analysis, credit risk, audit, or corporate finance.
* Strong understanding of financial statements, core credit risk principles, and familiarity with project finance, corporate, or sovereign risk concepts.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel, with foundational knowledge of Power BI and/or SQL considered a plus.
* Working knowledge of Risk Management, Regulatory Compliance, and Financial Reporting frameworks.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with business and technical stakeholders, including senior leadership.
* Demonstrated automation and innovation mindset, with willingness to improve processes and tools.
* Strong command of written and spoken professional English.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly.


**Good\-to\-have:**
* Professional certifications such as FRM, CFA, or PRM.
* Regulatory exposure or experience in areas such as Credit Underwriting, Basel frameworks, and CCAR.
* Familiarity with risk‑management systems, tools, or platforms.
* Willingness to travel based on client or project requirements.
* Previous project management experience
* Proficiency in French is highly advantageous and may be required for certain engagements.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Finance Executive
description:
**Role:** 
 Finance Associate
 



**Location:** 
 Pune, India (On\-site, Full\-time)

 Founders

 We are a fast\-growing consumer brand built to reduce screen time through interactive products. We are a validated business\-a Shark Tank India alum, venture\-backed by a top family office, and currently expanding into interactive building sets for kidults through our dedicated sub\-brand.

 We are not looking for a traditional record\-keeper. Most of our routine compliance, invoice processing, and daily MIS are already automated into a live dashboard. We need someone to interpret what those numbers mean and guide strategic decisions. As we scale volume and raise capital periodically, our financial data needs to be fast, accurate, and defensible.

* **Statutory \& Compliance:** 
 Bookkeeping, GST filings, and statutory requirements across a multi\-state footprint.

 The monthly close and MIS pack.

 Marketplace settlements reconciled across every sales channel.

 We are looking for a Manager – Credit Risk to lead credit risk, underwriting and risk consulting engagements.  What we are looking for

* Experience with process design, SOP development, automation or analytics initiatives.

title: P2P Operations Lead
description:
**Who We Are**
 Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI\-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,400 firms in nearly 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $9 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with nearly 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end\-to\-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, London, Edinburgh, Pune, Dubai, Geneva, Singapore and São Paulo.
   

  

**The Role**
 We are establishing a Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) team in India to support our global Finance organization. As the P2P Operations Lead, you will build and lead our new P2P Shared Services function in India, overseeing the operational execution of supplier onboarding, purchase order administration, invoice processing, and governance activities while partnering with Procurement and Accounts Payable to deliver a scalable, world\-class Procure\-to\-Pay operation.
   

  

 This role requires someone with deep Coupa and NetSuite experience, a strong command of P2P end\-to\-end process flows, and the maturity to operate independently with limited in\-person oversight.
   

  

 Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
**Procurement Operations**
* Own the end\-to\-end supplier onboarding process, including reviewing complete documentation and adhesion to internal policies.
* Maintain supplier records to ensure up\-to\-date supplier details and status
* Administer procurement workflows within Coupa and NetSuite.
* Manage Purchase Order (PO) lifecycle, including maintaining accurate PO billing and purchase details, monitoring open POs, and managing PO closures
* Coordinate supplier onboarding and supplier master maintenance.
* Review supplier onboarding documentation and ensure compliance with internal policies.


**Accounts Payable Operations**
* Lead the day\-to\-day execution of Accounts Payable operations, ensuring timely and accurate processing of invoices, credit memos, and payment requests.
* Oversee invoice validation, coding, approvals, and exception resolution.
* Ensure invoices are processed in accordance with company policies, approval workflows, and payment terms.
* Monitor AP aging and resolve outstanding issues to minimize overdue invoices.
* Support month\-end close activities by ensuring timely invoice processing, resolving outstanding items, and providing operational support for AP accruals.
* Partner with Procurement, AP, and business stakeholders to resolve discrepancies and ensure timely processing.


**Process Improvement \& Governance**
* Ensure adherence to P2P policies, procedures, and standard operating procedures.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve efficiency.
* Monitor key operational metrics, including supplier onboarding turnaround, PO cycle times, invoice processing, and exception rates.
* Support internal and external audits and ensure compliance with procurement policies and internal controls.


**Stakeholder Management**
* Serve as the primary point of contact for P2P operational queries and escalations.
* Partner with Procurement, Finance, Treasury, Legal, IT, and business stakeholders to deliver an efficient and scalable P2P process.


**Team Leadership**
* Recruit, onboard, coach, and develop P2P analysts.
* Establish training plans, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and knowledge\-sharing practices.
* Build a high\-performing team focused on operational excellence, customer service, and continuous improvement.
* Manage team capacity, workload, and service levels to support a growing global organization.


**What You'll Bring**
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 5–8 years of experience spanning both Accounts Payable and Procurement operations, ideally in a shared services, GBS, or high\-growth SaaS/technology environment.
* Required — Coupa: Deep, hands\-on proficiency in Coupa (purchase orders, supplier onboarding, invoice management, SPA workflows) is required.
* NetSuite (Preferred) or any other ERP: Hands\-on proficiency for AP and vendor management workflows is required.
* Experience with expense management tools like Navan
* Working knowledge of G/L coding, amortization schedules, and basic accounting principles as they apply to P2P.
* A proactive, ownership\-driven mindset and proven ability to operate independently with minimal oversight, managing competing priorities across high\-volume transactional workflows.
* Experience supporting US\-based or international stakeholders in a shared services or offshore capacity, with strong communication skills.
* Proven experience in team leadership, with the ability to hire, manage, and develop junior team members.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience in a high\-growth SaaS or technology company.
* Hands\-on experience implementing or scaling P2P processes from scratch.
* Exposure to procurement automation or workflow optimization tools.
* Familiarity with SOX controls or internal audit requirements.
* Experience working in a multi\-entity or global finance environment.
* Strong understanding of spend management platforms or similar tools.


**Important Note \- The roles requires the candidates to work out of our Kalyani Nagar,Pune office 3 days a week (Hybrid role)**
**Our Values**
* Act Like an Owner \- Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together \- Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients \- Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation \- Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning \- Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.


 In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
   

  

 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
   

  

 PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta\-operations@addepar.com.

 As a Manager in our Global Treasury Advisory Services team, you will manage and execute these complex Treasury engagements. If you’re looking for a diverse range of responsibilities with some of the most prestigious clients in multiple markets, you’ll find that here.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 You’re likely to balance your time between personally executing client engagements, developing our business and processes, and managing a varied pipeline. That will mean working on new projects, as well as extensions for existing products, so you’ll be actively influencing a range of client relationships. We’ll also look to you to coach, support, and manage internal resources and demonstrate professionalism while working in the client environment. You will be expected to provide supervision and mentoring to staff and serve as point person for technical questions. Specific responsibilities would include, but not be limited to:

* Supporting engagement planning, budgeting, execution and management
* Creating process flows and design documents, workshops and tools
* Overseeing end\-user training and support

* Maintaining an up\-to\-date understanding of tools, practices, and trends in a wide range of areas, including in\-house cash, bank structure, communications, account G/L structure, intercompany processes, liquidity planning and payments processing. Strong analytical and technical skills
* Strong communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills


**To qualify for the role you must have**
* A bachelor’s degree and 5 to 8 years of relevant work experience
* Achieved, or be working towards a professional designation, such as CTP, CFA, CPA, FRM
* A proven record of problem solving and analytical thinking within a global corporate treasury or consulting business
* Advanced skills and experience with: Treasury organizational structure and transformation, financial risk management, cash flow forecasting, analytics, liquidity management, cash and bank relationship management, international treasury centers, debt and investment management, due diligence, governance and controls, carve outs, and hedge accounting
* The confidence to train and mentor junior colleagues, providing the knowledge, skills and opportunities they need to excel
* Excellent sales and influencing skills, and the ability to present credibly to senior clients and colleagues
* Valid passport required; willingness and ability to travel internationally
* The ability and willingness to travel and work in excess of standard hours when necessary
* Access to reliable transportation to/from the EY office and client sites. A driver’s license is strongly recommended as ride share and public transportation options may not be available in all locations


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* A master’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration, financial engineering, economics, information technology, information systems, engineering or another relevant discipline
* Certified Treasury Professional qualification
* CFA designation (or CFA candidate)
* Consulting experience on complex projects
* System selection and implementation experience


**What We Look For**
 We’re interested in natural problem\-solvers and leaders, with proven project management and engagement experience. You’ll have the ability to prioritize when working on multiple engagements, as well as the ability to communicate complex information simply and effectively to audiences from all backgrounds. If you’re a global treasury professional looking to further your career as part of a highly collaborative team, this role is for you.
   

  

**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.
   

  

* We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job is:
* 
+ New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $154,000 to $256,700
+ Bay Area California offices – $160,500 to $267,400
+ All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $128,400 to $235,300

* Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
* Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well\-being.

title: Senior Manager-Order to Cash Lead
description:
**Who We Are**
 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
   

  

 As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
   

  

 We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
   

  

 \#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture
   

  

**About This Role**
 We are seeking an Order to Cash Lead to oversee end\-to\-end accounts receivable activities, including invoicing, collections, cash application, accounting, reconciliations and controls. The role is based in Pune and focuses on delivering accurate, timely finance operations while driving continuous improvement, compliance, stakeholder collaboration and service excellence across global finance operations.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Lead daily Order to Cash and accounts receivable operations, ensuring activities such as invoicing, collections, cash application, accounting, reconciliations and controls are completed accurately and on time.
   

  

 Work in line with defined operating procedures, policies, SOX, compliance requirements and business partner service level agreements.
   

  

 Collaborate with Global Process Owners, local markets, Finance Operations teams and Finance Business Partners to support sustainable improvements and consistent service delivery
   

  

 Lead and support a team involved in world\-class transactional processing and business partner excellence.
   

  

 Drive process improvement initiatives by identifying development needs, analysing performance trends and supporting practical changes that improve quality, controls and operational efficiency.
   

  

 Support month\-end, half\-year and year\-end finance activities, including balance sheet reconciliations and issue resolution
   

  

 Build strong stakeholder relationships and support proactive issue resolution to improve customer and business partner experience
   

  

 Maintain a strong governance and control environment through adherence to Group policies, audit requirements and key control expectations.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 You have strong experience in Order to Cash, accounts receivable management and finance operations.
   

  

 You bring sound knowledge of invoicing, collections, cash application, accounting, reconciliations, controls and compliance requirements.
   

  

 You are confident working with global stakeholders, Finance Business Partners and cross\-functional teams in a multicultural environment.
   

  

 You have experience leading teams and supporting capability development, performance management and operational delivery.
   

  

 You demonstrate clear communication, stakeholder management, governance, problem\-solving and process performance analysis skills.
   

  

 You have working experience with SAP and shared services operations.
   

  

 You hold a degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance or a related discipline.
   

  

 You have significant experience in Order to Cash or accounts receivable management.
   

  

 Knowledge of Agile methodology would be an advantage.
   

  

**Not a perfect fit?**
 Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
   

  

**What's In It For You**
 Opportunity to lead a sizeable finance operations team and contribute to high\-quality Order to Cash delivery across a global shared services environment.
   

  

 Exposure to global finance processes, local market stakeholders, Finance Business Partners and wider Finance Operations teams.
   

  

 Scope to influence process improvement, service quality, controls and operational performance across end\-to\-end accounts receivable activities.
   

  

 A role that supports professional growth in stakeholder management, governance, compliance and continuous improvement.
   

  

**What Skills You Will Learn**
 End\-to\-end leadership of Order to Cash operations in a global shared services environment.
   

  

 Advanced stakeholder engagement across global process, local market and finance business partner teams.
   

  

 Practical application of SOX, compliance, control frameworks and audit readiness in finance operations.
   

  

 Continuous improvement methods for enhancing process quality, service delivery and operational performance.
   

  

 People leadership skills, including coaching, team development and supporting performance outcomes.
   

  

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
 Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio\-economic background.
   

  

**Join Us**
 At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
   

  

 We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
   

  

 With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

**Job Description**
**Job Summary:**
 Accountable for the Record to Report (RtR) process and enterprise Master Data domains (Finance, Customer, Vendor, Material) within GBS.
   

  

 Responsible to design and govern end\-to\-end RtR processes and Master Data lifecycle (creation, change, governance, quality), and to lead and deliver a portfolio of global transformation initiatives across process, systems, and data.
   

  

 Drives standardization, control, and efficiency, ensures data integrity for financial and operational processes, and collaborates across Finance, Sales, Procurement, and Supply Chain to deliver business outcomes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities:**
**Process \& Data Ownership**
* Own end\-to\-end RtR process and enterprise Master Data governance framework
* Define and maintain global process and data standards, ownership model, and controls
* Ensure alignment of Master Data across Finance, Customer, Vendor, and Material domains
* Act as primary point of accountability for process integrity and data quality impacting financial reporting


**Project \& Transformation Leadership**
* Own and manage global portfolio of RtR and Master Data transformation initiatives
* Lead delivery of strategic programs (ERP initiatives, automation, data governance, harmonization, centralization)
* Define priorities, business cases, and implementation roadmap aligned with GBS and Finance strategy
* Ensure delivery of measurable outcomes (cost, quality, control, scalability)
* Manage cross\-functional dependencies across Finance, O2C, P2P, and Supply Chain
* Ensure strong project governance, risk management, and escalation


**Performance \& Continuous Improvement**
* Define and monitor KPIs for:
+ Process performance (cycle time, cost, efficiency)
+ Master Data quality (accuracy, completeness, timeliness) across all domains

* Drive continuous improvement based on performance insights
* Track project delivery and benefits realization


**Governance \& Operating Model**
* Define global operating model for RtR and cross\-functional Master Data
* Align ownership across GBS, Corporate, and business functions
* Enforce standards through governance mechanisms and stakeholder management
* Ensure alignment with regulatory, audit, and control requirements (incl. SOX where applicable)


**Stakeholder Management**
* Partner with Finance, Sales, Procurement, and Supply Chain leaders to align on process and data ownership
* Drive adoption of global standards and data governance principles
* Resolve cross\-functional conflicts related to process or data decisions
* Report performance, risks, and transformation progress to senior leadership


**Transformation \& Go\-Live Readiness**
* Ensure readiness of RtR and Master Data for system implementations and business transitions
* Oversee data migration, cleansing, validation, and reconciliation
* Ensure cross\-domain data dependencies are managed (customer, vendor, material impacting financial postings)


**Qualifications**
**Education and Experience**
* Experience in GBS / SSC / BPO environment
* 8\+ years in RtR process ownership roles with strong exposure to Master Data governance
* Proven track record leading large\-scale global transformation programs
* Strong experience in:
* Process design and standardization
* Master Data management across Finance, Customer, Vendor, Material
* SAP experience required, including relevant Master Data domains
* Experience in automation, digitalization, and continuous improvement programs
* Understanding of financial controls and impact on reporting


**Additional Qualifications**
* Strong business acumen and ownership mindset
* Ability to drive cross\-functional data ownership and enforce standards
* Strong program and project management capability
* Resilient, proactive, and execution\-focused
* Strong stakeholder and communication skills across matrix organization
* High process and data orientation with focus on integrity, control, and scalability


**About Us**
 Our purpose at Avient Corporation is to be an innovator of materials solutions that help our customers succeed, while enabling a sustainable world.
   

  

 Innovation goes far beyond materials science; it’s powered by the passion, creativity, and diverse expertise of 9,000 professionals worldwide. Whether you’re a finance wizard, a tech enthusiast, an operational powerhouse, an HR changemaker, or a trailblazer in materials development, you’ll find your place at Avient.
   

  

 Join our global team and help shape the future with sustainable solutions that transform possibilities into realities. Your unique perspective could be the key to our next breakthrough!
   

  

 We believe that all of our global employees are leaders and that the six most important behaviors for driving our strategy and culture are the same no matter if an employee is a leader of self, a leader of others, or a leader of the business.
   

  

 By
 *playing to win, acting customer centric, driving innovation and profitable growth, collaborating seamlessly across Avient, and motivating and inspiring and developing others and yourself* 
 you will accelerate your ability to achieve Avient’s strategic goals, to meet our customer needs, and to accomplish your career goals.
   

  

 At Avient, we believe a wide variety of thoughts, ideas and backgrounds gives us the creativity to be successful in a rapidly changing world. In support of this, we stress equality of opportunity for all qualified individuals in accordance with applicable laws. Decisions on hiring, promotion, development, compensation or advancement are based solely on a person’s qualifications, abilities, experience and performance.

title: Operations and Supply chain Manager
description:
****About SKF****

 SKF started its operations in India in 1923\. Today, SKF provides industry leading automotive and industrial engineered solutions through its five technology\-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals, mechatronics, lubrication solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from being a pioneer ball bearing manufacturing company to a knowledge\-driven engineering company helping customers achieve sustainable and competitive business excellence.
   

  





 SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the automotive and industrial sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency, and equipment longevity and reliability. With a strong commitment to research\-based innovation, SKF India offers customized value\-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms.
   

  





 To know more, please visit: www.skf.com /in
   

  





**SKF Purpose Statement**




 Together, we re\-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.
   

  





 By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet
   

  





****JOB DESCRIPTION****




**Position Title:** 
 Operations \& Supply Chain Manager, Services
   

  





**Role Type:** 
 Individual Contribution
   

  





**Location:** 
 Pune
   

  





****Job Responsibilities****




 The Operational Manager will be responsible for end\-to\-end supply chain operations including procurement of manpower services, site specific material, Inventory management, demand planning, supplier management, and customer service. Ensuring effective coordination between site teams, suppliers, and supply chain functions to enable uninterrupted service execution and drive operational efficiency to support business growth
   

  





****Key Responsibilities****




**Manpower Services Procurement**




 Identify, evaluate, and onboard manpower service vendors for service sites across multiple customer locations.
   

  





 Conduct vendor capability, compliance, and commercial evaluations.
   

  





 Negotiate commercial terms and finalize manpower service contracts.
   

  





 Coordinate with Legal for contract vetting, CMS uploading, and timely execution.
   

  





 Manage contract\-related issues and resolve vendor conflicts to ensure continuity of operations.
   

  





 Ensure compliance with statutory, labor, and contractual requirements.
   

  





**Spares \& Consumables Procurement**




 Identify and develop suppliers for spares and consumables required for site service operations.
   

  





 Coordinate with site and engineering teams to understand material requirements.
   

  





 Negotiate pricing, delivery terms, and service levels with suppliers.
   

  





 Monitor supplier performance on cost, quality, and availability.
   

  





 IMS / Inventory / VMI Support (Coordination Role)
   

  





 Support IMS contracts including Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) in coordination with site teams, customer service and SKF distributors.
   

  





 Monitor stock levels, consumption trends, and replenishment cycles.
   

  





 Review inventory accuracy between physical stock and SAP records.
   

  





 Support monitoring of IMS KPIs such as stock availability and service fill rate through coordination with site operations.
   

  





**Customer Service \& Supply Chain Transaction Monitoring**




 Monitor job\-related service transactions including material issue and consumption.
   

  





 Track procurement, inventory, and service transactions in SAP systems.
   

  





 Coordinate with Service Execution, Supply Chain, and Finance teams to ensure transactional accuracy and timely closures.
   

  





 Identify transaction gaps or delays and support resolution with operational teams.
   

  





****Qualifications \& Experience****




 Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical preferred) or Commerce / Management.
   

  





 5\-7 years of experience in procurement, service contracts, or supply chain roles within industrial / steel / heavy engineering environments.
   

  





 Strong experience in manpower service contracting and vendor negotiations.
   

  





 Hands\-on exposure to SAP systems for procurement, inventory, and service transactions.
   

  





 Experience working across multiple customer locations and stakeholders.
   

  





**Interested candidates can share their resume to : prachi.chourasia@skf.com**




****About SKF****




 SKF has been around for more than a century and today we are one of the world’s largest global suppliers of bearings and supporting solutions for rotating equipment. With more than 40,000 employees in around 130 countries, we are truly global. Our products are found everywhere in society. In fact, wherever there is movement, SKF’s solutions might be at work. This means that we are an important part of the everyday lives of people and companies around the world. See more, at www.skf.com.

description:
**Manager – Accounts \& Finance**




**Job Location: Pune (Camp)** 




**Industry: Real Estate / Construction / Promoter \& Developer** 




**Reporting to: Head – Finance / CFO** 




  





**Position Overview** 




 We are looking for an experienced and technology\-savvy Manager – Accounts \& Finance to lead the Accounting, Financial Reporting, FP\&A and Tax Compliance functions for a leading promoter, developer and construction group in Pune.
 



 The role will be responsible for ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting, smooth monthly closing, effective tax compliance, robust MIS and FP\&A support, and efficient utilisation of the organisation’s ERP system. The position will also lead and mentor the accounting team and drive process discipline, automation and continuous improvement.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




  





**Accounting \& Financial Reporting** 




 Lead day\-to\-day accounting operations across the group and ensure accuracy, completeness and timely recording of financial transactions.
 



 Drive the monthly, quarterly and annual financial close process.
 



 Review general ledger, reconciliations, provisions, accruals, revenue, costs, receivables, payables and other accounting schedules.
 



 Ensure appropriate accounting treatment for construction projects, development activities, land transactions, project costs and related\-party transactions.
 



 Prepare and review financial statements and management reporting in accordance with applicable accounting standards.
 



  





**MIS, FP\&A \& Business Support** 




 Lead preparation of monthly MIS, project\-wise profitability reports, budgets, forecasts, cash\-flow projections and variance analysis.
 



 Provide meaningful financial insights to management on project performance, costs, margins, working capital and cash flows.
 



 Develop and improve management dashboards and analytical reports to support business decision\-making.
 



 Work closely with project, commercial, procurement and business teams to ensure timely and accurate financial information.
 



  





**Tax \& Statutory Compliance** 




 Oversee direct and indirect tax compliance, including GST, TDS, Income Tax and other applicable statutory requirements.
 



 Ensure timely filing of returns, payments, reconciliations and responses to tax/statutory queries.
 



 Coordinate with external tax advisors, auditors and consultants wherever required.
 



 Monitor changes in tax laws and assess their impact on the business.
 



  





**ERP \& Process Management** 




 Take ownership of the ERP system from a finance and accounting perspective and ensure smooth and effective utilisation by the accounting and business teams.
 



 Work with ERP teams/consultants to configure processes, improve controls and develop MIS reports.
 



 Should have the ability to understand business requirements and design/define ERP\-based MIS and reporting solutions.
 



 Experience with ERP platforms such as Highrise, SAP or equivalent will be an advantage.
 



 Drive standardisation, automation, internal controls and continuous improvement of finance processes.
 



  





**Audit \& Compliance** 




 Coordinate statutory, tax and internal audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
 



 Maintain appropriate documentation and supporting schedules for audit and management review.
 



 Strengthen financial controls and ensure compliance with internal policies and procedures.
 



  





**Team Leadership** 




 Lead, guide and motivate the accounting team to deliver accurate, timely and reliable financial information.
 



 Allocate responsibilities, monitor performance and develop team capabilities.
 



 Establish a process\-oriented and accountability\-driven culture within the finance function.
 



  





**Required Skills \& Competencies**




 In\-depth knowledge of accounting, financial reporting and month\-end/year\-end close processes.
 



 Strong understanding of the real estate, construction, promoter and developer business, including project accounting and project\-wise financial analysis.
 



 Strong knowledge of FP\&A, MIS, budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis.
 



 Good understanding of GST, TDS, Income Tax and other statutory compliances relevant to the business.
 



 Strong ERP knowledge with the ability to use technology for process improvement and MIS development.
 



 Experience with Highrise, SAP or similar ERP systems will be preferred.
 



 Technology\-savvy and comfortable working with ERP, reporting tools, Excel and data\-driven financial analysis.
 



 Strong process orientation, attention to detail and analytical ability.
 



 Excellent people\-management, communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
 



 Ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables in a fast\-paced business environment.
 



  





**Qualification \& Experience**




 Chartered Accountant (CA) with 5 years of post qualification experience or completion of CA article ship with 10 years of experience in leading the accounting/finance function.
 



 Candidates with substantial experience in a real estate, construction, promoter or developer organization will be strongly preferred.
 



 Proven experience in managing accounting teams and delivering monthly MIS, financial close, statutory compliance and management reporting.
 



  





**Key Success Measures**




 Timely and accurate monthly financial close.
 



 Quality and timeliness of MIS and management reporting.
 



 Effective project\-wise financial and cost reporting.
 



 Timely statutory and tax compliance.
 



 Smooth and effective ERP operations.
 



 Strong financial controls and audit readiness.
 



 Improved finance processes, automation and reporting.
 



 Effective leadership and development of the accounting team.

title: Data Intelligence Manager
description:
**Who We’re Looking For**
 Fieldwire is looking for a Data Intelligence Manager to join our Data \& Operations team based in Pune, India. You will be the operational owner of reporting and analytics for a core business function (G\&A, R\&D, or GTM), turning raw data into accurate, timely, and trusted intelligence that drive decisions at the executive and departmental level. You will work closely with our Data Engineers, DIM Team Lead, and business partners to build dashboards, define KPIs, and maintain rigorous data quality. This role is critical to the integrity and scalability of our reporting landscape.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
**The primary responsibilities for this role include:**
* Own the end\-to\-end delivery of non\-native dashboards for your assigned business function (G\&A, R\&D, or GTM), combining data across multiple source systems into a single, accurate view
* Build, maintain, and continuously improve dashboards and BI products (Power BI or equivalent), ensuring they are always live, accurate, and clearly documented
* Define and govern KPIs and performance metrics for your business area, ensuring consistent definitions across teams and regions
* Act as the primary business partner for stakeholders in your assigned function — translating business questions into analytical requirements and delivering clear, decision\-ready intelligence
* Conduct extensive QA on all data outputs: validate inputs, test transformations, reconcile outputs against source systems, and prevent conflicting or duplicate reporting
* Maintain a single source of truth for your reporting area, ensuring consistency across all dashboards and outputs
* Manage a release and change control process for dashboard updates — including testing, versioning, and stakeholder communication before any changes go live
* Monitor data quality continuously; detect and escalate anomalies, breaks, or integrity issues early
* Document all metrics, logic, and definitions clearly so that any stakeholder can understand what the data means and how it is calculated
* Contribute to cross\-training within the DIM team to ensure coverage and reduce single points of failure
* Support the DIM Team Lead and Director of Operations in roadmap planning and continuous improvement of the reporting landscape


**At Fieldwire, we’re looking for our next Data Intelligence Manager to have the following skills and experiences:**
* 3\-5 years of experience in a data analytics, business intelligence, or data intelligence role
* Strong proficiency in SQL and hands\-on experience building dashboards in Power BI

 We are seeking an exceptional individual to support ongoing enhancements to the Vendor Risk Management program through data management, documentation, and engagement with the program framework, processes, and platforms.  The VRMP Analyst will be responsible for executing goals related to process enhancement and vendor inventory enrichment projects primarily through day\-to\-day support tasks. These tasks will include managing vendor data and inventory and supporting the annual vendor due diligence questionnaire exercise. This role would include configuring ProcessUnity, sending the questionnaires, and tracking responses. The candidate will also look for opportunities to improve our operational processes.

 AB has a long history of adhering to and promoting strong professional ethics and is committed to conducting our business according to the highest standards of honesty and fairness. Assessing and managing Vendor risk is key to delivering on these standards and AB considers topics such as our vendors’ policies and practices for data privacy, cybersecurity, business continuity, ESG, and financial health. The VRMP team provides support to business units and individual vendor relationship managers so they can complete these assessments and mitigate risks appropriately. We manage our vendor inventory in ProcessUnity, execute configuration in ProcessUnity per the process maturation and conduct vendor risk due diligence primarily through an annual due diligence questionnaire exercise. Planned process enhancements include creating intersystem (contract management, accounts payable, CMDB), cross\-functional (Cybersecurity, Modern Slavery, Data Privacy, Business Continuity, Legal \& Compliance, and others) linkages to create a comprehensive risk view of all third\-party engagements.

 Global Revenue Accounting (GRA) is a specialized global team performing ASC 606 revenue accounting out of Pune. As a General Accountant II, you will serve as an integral Finance Partner to ensure seamless business continuity, safeguard our internal control environment, and maintain our operational cadence. This is an individual contributor role with direct exposure to high\-level finance leadership, as your reports and reconciliations directly impact the organization's final revenue and top line.
   

  

**About The Responsibilities**
* Revenue Accounting \& ASC 606 Compliance:
+ Perform monthly revenue accruals and deferrals in strict adherence to ASC 606 requirements.
+ Conduct regular project reviews with the APS finance team to align project and POC status with Revenue Guidelines and RAR.
+ Execute monthly cut\-off procedures for Hardware (HW) and Software (SW) based on Incoterms and LAC details.
+ Manage revenue allocation processes to determine accurate contract asset and liability positions.


* Internal Controls \& SOX Governance:
+ Execute quarterly SOX controls and ensure timely closure during Quarter\-End Close (QEC).
+ Address PWC audit inquiries, deal reviews, and contract modifications related to prior closes.


* Reconciliations \& Financial Reporting:
+ Perform quarterly reconciliations to substantiate Revenue\-related Balance Sheet GL accounts (including ST \& LT Contract Assets, Contract Liabilities, and AR Adjustments).
+ Prepare the Balance Sheet Review Deck, providing thorough Quarter\-over\-Quarter (QoQ) and Year\-over\-Year (YoY) variance explanations for Revenue GLs.
+ Automate manual reporting processes to enhance close efficiency.


**Who We Are Looking For \-**
* Education: Qualified CA, CIMA, M.Com, or MBA in Finance (or equivalent field). Bachelor's degree in Finance required.
* Experience: 5 to 10 years of hands\-on experience in global revenue accounting, statutory book closures, and ASC 606 standards.
* Technical Skills: Advanced MS Excel skills, strong financial analysis capabilities, and experience with Revenue Automation tools (RAR) and SOX controls.
* Soft Skills: Exceptional communication, strong logical problem\-solving skills, high attention to detail, and a collaborative "finisher" mindset.
* Work Schedule: Ability to stretch and work extended hours/weekends during quarterly close cycles to meet strict Close Calendar deadlines. No travel required.

* Preparation of Bills of Materials (BOM), vendor enquiries, techno\-commercial evaluations, and detailed cost estimates
* Cost optimization, value engineering, and proposal preparation for industrial burner packages

 **API** 
 ,
 **ASME**

 **IEC** 
 , and
 **ISA is preferred.**

* 10–15 years of experience in estimation, proposal engineering, or applications engineering for industrial combustion systems.

* Provide analytical insights on churn, customer loyalty, customer profitability, customer behavior, and revenue leakage to support strategic decision\-making
  
* Act as a core member of the pricing committee and provide inputs on price structuring, discount governance, customer viability, renewal economics, and commercial risk.
   

 Customer Contracts, Churn Mitigation \& Legal Partnership
  
* Participate in the customer contract committee and advise on payment terms, collection enforceability, contract risk, churn triggers, discounting terms, and revenue protection clauses
  
* Work closely with Legal to resolve overdue accounts, contract disputes, collection challenges, and escalations requiring formal recovery or negotiation
  
* Develop mitigation practices to reduce churn, improve customer stickiness, and strengthen contract hygiene across new and existing client relationships.
   

 Collections, International Banking \& Treasury Partnership
  
* Lead timely collections across geographies by addressing customer\-side issues, banking delays, failed payment flows, international remittance challenges, and process bottlenecks
  
* Partner with Treasury for cash forecasting, liquidity visibility, collection predictability, auto\-collection mechanisms, and banking process improvements
  
* Own DSO, CEI, ageing movement, overdue reduction, unapplied cash, and collection\-risk reporting with clear governance and escalation rhythm
  
* Digital Transformation, AI/RPA \& Control Tower
  
* Build a digital\-first O2C operating model through dashboards, RPA workflows, AI\-enabled anomaly detection, auto\-matching, cash application automation, and revenue/cash forecasting models
  
* Create exception\-based control towers for invoice accuracy, collections risk, pricing exceptions, contract\-related disputes, write\-offs, credit memos, and customer\-level exposure
  
* Drive business cases and ROI for collections platforms, EIPP/portals, cash application ML/IDP, workflow automation, and analytics\-led decision support
  
* O2C Operations, Revenue Accounting \& Controls
  
* Own end\-to\-end AR/O2C operations including billing accuracy, client invoicing, collections, cash application, credit notes, write\-off governance, revenue accounting, revenue gap assessment, and statutory audit support
  
* Strengthen controls around onboarding, KYC, credit limits, segregation of duties, audit trails, billing accuracy, tax/e\-invoicing readiness, and revenue handoffs
  
* Establish process discipline across customer master data, payment terms, dispute SLAs, credit governance, closing activities, and audit evidence readiness
  
* M\&A, New Service Lines \& Geographic Expansion Support
  
* Support due diligence for M\&A, acquire opportunities, new service lines, new geographies, and new end markets by evaluating customer contracts, revenue quality, receivables, collection risks, and integration readiness
  
* Standardize customer master data, collection policies, payment terms, and O2C controls where new entities, products, markets, or customer portfolios are integrated into TresVista’s operating model
  
* Stakeholder Management \& Leadership Rhythm
  
* Partner across Legal, Treasury, Corporate Finance, Commercial, Product, business teams, and leadership to identify risks early, solve cross\-functional issues, and drive accountable outcomes
  
* Run weekly exception and ageing reviews, monthly CFO/commercial reviews, and leadership packs covering cash, risk, churn, customer health, and transformation progress
  


  


**Decision Rights** 



  

  
* Recommend and approve O2C credit, collections, customer contract, and e\-billing governance standards in partnership with relevant stakeholders
  
* Prioritize the O2C automation roadmap, exception dashboards, workflow releases, and transformation initiatives in collaboration with IT and business teams
  
* Drive escalation decisions for overdue accounts, customer exposure, policy exceptions, and credit risk mitigation actions
  
* Propose transformation investments, vendor/platform requirements, ROI cases, and operating model changes for revenue\-to\-cash scalability
  


  


**Success Measures (KPIs)** 



  

  
* Reduction in DSO, overdue balances, delinquency movement, write\-offs, and unresolved disputes
  
* Improvement in CEI, timely collections, cash forecast accuracy, and customer\-level collection predictability
  
* First\-pass invoice accuracy, billing cycle\-time reduction, reduction in pricing/contract/tax\-related rework, and faster audit evidence turnaround
  
* Improvement in ARR visibility, ARR added by channel/product, churn insights, discount governance, customer lifetime value understanding, and revenue leakage prevention
  
* Automation adoption, cash application auto\-match percentage, anomaly detection effectiveness, dashboard adoption, and measurable transformation ROI
  
* Improved stakeholder satisfaction across commercial, legal, treasury, finance, product, and leadership teams
  


  


**Prerequisites:** 



  

  
* Chartered Accountant with 8 to 14 years of experience across Order to Cash, Accounts Receivable, revenue accounting, commercial finance, credit risk, collections, or transformation\-led finance operations

description:
**Responsibilities**
 Senior Estimator
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Senior Estimator is responsible for leading the development, estimation, and delivery of high\-quality technical and commercial proposals for strategic Integrated Control \& Safety System (ICSS) projects. The role provides end\-to\-end ownership of the proposal process, including solution development, cost estimation, risk assessment, stakeholder coordination, vendor engagement, governance approvals, proposal submission, and post\-bid support.
   

  

 Working closely with Sales, Operations, Engineering, Procurement, Finance, and external partners, the Senior Estimator develops competitive, compliant, and profitable solutions that maximize customer value while supporting Honeywell's strategic growth objectives. The role requires strong technical expertise, commercial acumen, leadership capability, and the ability to manage complex bid activities across multiple stakeholders and regions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities** 
**Proposal Leadership and Strategy**
* Lead and coordinate cross\-functional proposal teams to develop accurate, compliant, and commercially competitive proposals within established timelines.
* Own the end\-to\-end proposal development process, from opportunity qualification through submission and post\-bid support.
* Participate in bid/no\-bid reviews and contribute to proposal strategy, risk mitigation, and win themes.
* Prepare and maintain comprehensive Proposal Execution Plans, including resource allocation, deliverables, responsibilities, milestones, and submission schedules.
* Lead the preparation and successful submission of large\-scale, complex proposals and tenders, including multi\-country and international projects.


**Technical Solution Development**
* Analyze customer requirements, requests for quotation, specifications, and supporting documents to develop technically compliant and commercially viable solutions.
* Analyze, design, and develop end\-to\-end ICSS solutions, with a primary focus on Distributed Control Systems (DCS), SCADA, Process Safety Systems, PLCs, and associated automation technologies.
* Develop innovative technical and commercial alternatives that optimize competitiveness, profitability, risk profile, and customer value.
* Ensure proposed solutions align with customer requirements and Honeywell strategic initiatives, including market verticalization, new product introduction, and other growth priorities.


**Estimating and Commercial Management**
* Prepare accurate cost estimates and commercial proposals for greenfield, brownfield, modernization, and service projects using approved methodologies, tools, and procedures.
* Conduct commercial reviews to identify risks, opportunities, cost drivers, and margin improvement initiatives.
* Develop pricing strategies that balance market competitiveness, customer value, and business profitability objectives.
* Use applicable systems and tools to maintain accurate documentation of estimates, proposals, assumptions, exclusions, and supporting information.


**Vendor and Stakeholder Management**
* Coordinate with Procurement and supporting functions to obtain technical and commercial quotations from suppliers, subcontractors, and third\-party vendors.
* Establish and maintain effective working relationships with Sales, Operations, Engineering, Finance, Procurement, suppliers, and customers to support proposal success.
* Collaborate with regional and global teams to develop optimized technical and commercial solutions.


**Proposal Governance and Compliance**
* Ensure complete and compliant responses to customer bid packages, including all required technical submissions, commercial documents, scope of supply, and supporting information.
* Prepare and submit required approval documentation in accordance with Honeywell governance requirements.
* Ensure proposals comply with customer specifications, company standards, contractual requirements, and applicable regulations.


**Post\-Bid Support and Continuous Improvement**
* Support customer technical and commercial clarification activities following proposal submission and update proposals as required.
* Continuously enhance knowledge of Honeywell solutions, industry trends, competitor offerings, and market developments.
* Drive standardization, process improvement, estimating best practices, and continuous improvement initiatives across the estimating community.
* Provide coaching, guidance, and mentoring to junior estimators and proposal engineers.


**Qualifications**
**Key Skills and Qualifications** 
**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline.


**Experience**
* 10\+ years of experience in Process Automation, Industrial Control Systems, or related engineering solutions.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in estimating, proposal management, bid execution, or commercial engineering roles.
* Proven experience successfully delivering complete proposals for large and complex projects, including international opportunities.


**Technical Competencies**
* Strong understanding of process industries, including Oil \& Gas, Refining, Petrochemicals, LNG, Power, Mining, Metals, and Minerals.
* Demonstrated technical expertise in Industrial Control Systems, including DCS, SCADA, PLC, and Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS).
* Experience with Honeywell automation solutions, including Experion, Safety Manager, FSC, and related technologies, is highly desirable.


**Leadership and Commercial Skills**
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence cross\-functional teams in a matrix organization.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, including project costing, pricing strategy, margin analysis, and risk assessment.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, negotiation, and decision\-making skills.
* Strong technical and integrative thinking skills, with the ability to develop innovative, customer\-focused solutions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at all organizational levels.


**We Value**
* Customer\-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering exceptional value and service.
* Strategic thinking and strong business acumen.
* Strong technical aptitude and systems\-thinking capability.
* Knowledge of Honeywell's automation portfolio and competitive industry solutions.
* Ability to drive results and perform effectively in a fast\-paced bid environment.
* Strong planning, organization, and prioritization skills.
* High attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Ability to work independently with limited direction while effectively leading project teams.
* Continuous learning mindset and commitment to professional development.
* Mentoring and coaching capability to support team development.
* Strong presentation and communication skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and related


**About Us**
 Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

**Company Description** 




 Xolopak India Ltd is a pioneering company in manufacturing sustainable consumable products for HORECA, Bakery and Home/Personal care industry in India. We operate in B2B and institutional business within this segment and have a pan India presence. Our products include single use wooden cutlery, ice\-cream sticks and spoons, cake bases, speciality papers, luxury napkins, thermal rolls etc. Our prestigious customers include some of the largest brands in the food and ice\-cream industry.
 



  





**Job Overview** 




 We are seeking a meticulous, responsible and efficient Accounts \& Finance Executive to join our Finance Team. The candidate will be responsible for managing day\-to\-day accounting, banking, accounts payable, reconciliations, audit support and maintenance of financial records. The role requires close coordination with internal departments, vendors, customers, banks, auditors and other stakeholders to ensure timely execution of financial transactions, accurate accounting records, effective internal controls and compliance with applicable requirements.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



1. **Banking Activities**



 • Responsible for day\-to\-day banking activities, including fund transfers, vendor payments, and other banking transactions.

 • Ensure timely completion and updation of KYC and other bank\-related compliances.

**3\. Financial Record\-Keeping:**

**4\. Compliance \& Internal Controls** 




 • Ensure compliance with company accounting policies, internal controls, and applicable statutory requirements.
 



 • Maintain proper documentation and approval trails for financial transactions.
 



 • Ensure segregation of duties and adherence to established finance processes.
 



 • Identify process gaps and highlight potential financial or control risks to the reporting manager.
 



 • Assist in strengthening and streamlining accounting and payment processes.
 



  





 5\.
 **Support Audit Activities:** 




 • Provide documentation and support during internal and external audits.
 



 • Implement audit recommendations as necessary.
 



  





 6\.
 **Other Duties** 
 :
 



 • Assist in other accounting functions and special projects as needed.
 



 • Collaborate with other departments to streamline processes and improve efficiency.
 



 • Perform any other duties and responsibilities assigned from time to time in the interest of the Company.

 :

**Experience**

title: Finance Partner - NVB Campus
description:
****Be part of something bigger!****
 As the world and the way people live is changing, we at Bekaert believe it’s our responsibility to contribute to finding new solutions for the future. With a 140\+ year old heritage of excellence, innovation, and a future\-focused mindset, we strive to create value for our customers and society. We aim to do this through innovative solutions and sustainable practices. We are committed to pushing the boundaries of steel wire transformation and coatings whilst also leveraging our expertise to develop innovative solutions with new materials and services in a safe, smart, and sustainable way. Our focus extends to markets such as new mobility, low\-carbon construction, and green energy.
   

  

 As a dynamic and growing company with over 19 000 employees worldwide, 75 nationalities, a retention rate above 90% and € 3,7 billion in combined revenue in 2025, we are looking for someone like you to join our team as we continue to shape a safer, more efficient, and connected world!
   

  

****I. Purpose of the Role****
 This position will focus on timely and accurate calculation and reporting of financial result of NVB (NV Bekaert) Campus in Belgium to have accurate reflection of campus costs. The candidate will also support financial reporting for the Sales / Trading entities in EMEA.
   

  

 The Candidate must be a team player and self\-starter too as the position needs working in cross functional teams to resolve issues having impact on multiple functions. The Candidate should also be able to handle the Projects \& its management independently, while maintaining Confidentiality of the Project wherever required.
   

  

****II. Roles and Responsibilities****
**Monthly Closing \& Reporting**
* Drive monthly activities, perform necessary analysis, checks and provide insights on Campus Costs.
* Ensures the timely execution of reports with data integrity in collaboration with Campus Management team and understand the build\-up of the figures and be ready to concisely reply on questions; drive corrective actions when needed.
* Timely reporting of accurate campus result, including comment letter. All follow up reports are updated in time, in good quality and reported to campus management.
* Support the Campus Management by providing financial metrics reports on critical topics \& Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
* Analyze all variances related to campus cost centers and reports to management.
* Support team in transforming reporting requirements on new reporting platform.
* Ad hoc financial analysis.
* Preparation of Management reports, checking of upload in consolidation tool.
* Purchase Price Variance (PPV) analysis \& provisioning.
* Material Price update in System.
* Calculating \& updating tariffs.
* Execution of assessment cycles for cost recharge.
* Transfer Price – calculation, review, update.
* Reports – Sales reports, Inventory reports., etc.


**Budgeting \& Forecasting**
* Drive annual planning cycles (X\+1\) for Campus (cost centers), Trading businesses.
* Prepare annual budget for the different campus cost centers and calculate the new rates for utilities, waste, maintenance hours.
* Maintains the master data and allocation rules to reflect correct campus costs in the budget of the plant.
* Co\-ordinate with various departments for Budget data gathering and preparation.
* Presents the annual campus budget to campus management.


**Campus Cost Analysis \& Allocation**
* Coordinates and monitors the timely cost bookings.
* Collect, analyze, and report on ad hoc questions about costs, and allocations.
* Monitors the different allocation keys to make sure all campus related costs are allocated to the plant by using the correct driver.
* Safeguard the accuracy of the costs booked on the campus cost centers and set up accruals if needed.
* Check and define in cooperation with Procurement team on a monthly basis, the new prices for utilities. Adjust the master data accordingly so correct utility costs are allocated to the production plants.
* Make sure the actual rates for utilities and waste are reflected in the allocations towards the production plants.
* Partnering with local plant management to answer to ad hoc questions.


**Internal Control \& Compliance**
* Monitor the financial procedures to ensure that systems and internal controls within the plant meet the needs of management and ensure that financial activities comply with applicable group rules.
* Supporting in various internal / external audits.


****III. Skills \& Competencies****
**Educational Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree or above, majoring in accounting, finance, or related field.
* Professional qualification as CMA, Post Graduate Programmed in Management (PGPM)


**Technical Skills**
* Knowledge and understanding of operations of accounting \& financial function is essential. Preferably prior financial analysis \& reporting experience across a complex manufacturing set\-up of significant scale, in a global international environment.
* Software knowledge – Expert in MS Office (Excel, PowerPivot, Power BI, Power point).
* SAP FI \& CO module experience.
* Knowledge of systems (preferred) – Consolidation tools \- Group Reporting, Planning tools \- SAP Analytical Cloud (SAC) and Central Finance (CFIN).


****Be bold and take the leap!****
 We're looking for individuals who are not afraid to take risks and explore new ideas. If you are passionate about personal growth and bringing your authentic self to work, we want you on our team!
   

  

 At Bekaert, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive work environment. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
